name: roblox-bytecode-dissassembler
description: A extension I made for myself to have a bytecode dissassembler for luau because I want to learn it.

commands.title: Luau: Reload Bytecode Panel (fix blank/broken panel)

luauBytecode.compilerPath.description: Absolute path to luau-compile(.exe). Overrides auto-detection.

luauBytecode.searchDirectories.description: Extra folders to search for luau-compile, checked before C:/Luau and H:/Luau.

luauBytecode.dumpConstants.description: Include each function's constant table in the disassembly.

luauBytecode.autoShow.description: Auto-open/update the panel on active .lua/.luau files. If false, use the 'Luau: Show Bytecode Panel' command.

luauBytecode.debounceMs.description: Milliseconds to wait after you stop typing before recompiling.

luauBytecode.expandOneLiners.description: Best-effort expansion of minified/one-line Luau source into multiple lines before compiling, so each bytecode instruction's source-line context is readable. Doesn't modify your actual file.

luauBytecode.largeOutputThreshold.description: Above this many lines of disassembly output, syntax highlighting falls back to a cheaper mode to avoid freezing on very large scripts.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
